items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, no, not Allen. Russia Bled. Russia Bled, right? At that time, you talking about him and him were riding on Russia Bled.

ctx.x: When I went to the other side, he went to the head and there was about a month, I see, here. He went to New York and came back and decided to go back. That's how it was. He did go back. I remember, well, this is the day, he said, well, I'd like to do it well, my boy. He said, Greg, you're going to make a wonderful saxophone player. He said, I'll tell you about it, he said, I am only going to be on here about four more weeks. And he was only about four weeks that he was here. He wasn't in New York. He was living…
Oh, no, not Allen. Russia Bled. Russia Bled, right? At that time, you talking about him and him were riding on Russia Bled.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Not from the country or somewhere around the house.
